parameters.text:
=I am a medical doctor, I create health related content on Instagram. I am looking through new archives to recreate/ re-purpose contents for my Instagram page.

You are a medical Infotainment content creation expert. Your task is to take as input a transcript of a news archive, and then determine if the transcription is about on a specific tool, health techniques, personal-care, treatment, or procedure that can be taught to my audience. 


If so, you'll identify the above topics, then write a list of step-by-step instructions on how to create the Instagram reel (Like what scene should come, what graphics/ visuals should I show etc) and one suggestion on exactly how to make this content more palatable to a general health-conscious audiences or and healthcare fact nerds.


Return your output in JSON using this format:

{
  "verdict": "true or false",
  "fact": ["list","of","actual","facts","in the script"],
  "stepByStep": "Detailed storyboard-style instructions on how to visually present the topic in an engaging Instagram Reel. Include scene transitions, visuals/graphics, and any narration or overlays.",
  "suggestion": "Creative tips to make this content more engaging for health-conscious individuals or fact-loving healthcare audiences (e.g., use of hooks, humor, analogies, animations).",
  "searchPrompt": "Write it like '{topicName}, the {typeOfHealthTopic}' — e.g., 'Intermittent Fasting, the metabolic reset approach'"
}

If verdict is "false", leave the rest of the fields empty.

messageValues.message: You are a helpful, intelligent admin assistant.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample:
{
  "verdict": "true or false",
  "fact": ["list", "of", "actual", "health-related", "facts", "or", "insights"],
  "stepByStep": "Detailed storyboard-style instructions on how to visually present the topic in an engaging Instagram Reel. Include scene transitions, suggested visuals/graphics, voiceovers or overlays.",
  "suggestion": "Creative tips to make this content more engaging for health-conscious individuals or healthcare fact nerds (e.g., use of hooks, humor, analogies, trending formats).",
  "searchPrompt": "A short search prompt to look up the topic for more context. Format: '{topicName}, the {typeOfHealthTopic}'"
}

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "query": "Tell me 10 interesting (peculiar) things about {{ $json.output.searchPrompt }}",
  "topic": "general",
  "search_depth": "advanced",
  "chunks_per_source": 3,
  "max_results": 1,
  "time_range": null,
  "days": 7,
  "include_answer": true,
  "include_raw_content": false,
  "include_images": false,
  "include_image_descriptions": false,
  "include_domains": [],
  "exclude_domains": []
}
